rules.unresolved_meaning: Exact input/evidence is unresolved for this project; it does not prove that the underlying capability is unimplemented.
rules.resolution: Retrieve existing allowed authoritative evidence before asking the owner. Record real decisions in their canonical authority; references here do not create approval.
rules.package_references: PEX-01 through PEX-10 are proposed project dependencies, not live task identities or dispatch instructions.

inputs.title: Release stage and target
required_resolution_fields: stage: preparation, testing, playable launch or an explicitly named approved alternative
target environment and world/profile identity
accepted scope or decision reference and effective release
inputs.retrieval_boundary: Check existing accepted release decisions first; missing runtime status must not choose the stage.
inputs.independent_work: Prepare alternative compositions; publish no stage-specific play promise.

inputs.title: Approved game fact sheet
required_resolution_fields: three or four verified differentiators with source evidence
approved rules/progression and supported features for the named profile
explicit treatment of rates, resets, economy and monetization claims
inputs.retrieval_boundary: Use allowed Platform contracts and accepted owner facts; external game sources require separate exact authority.
inputs.independent_work: Write neutral interface/help copy and draft claim slots without publishing guessed properties.

inputs.title: Location references and media provenance
required_resolution_fields: chosen location/profile revision and bounded reference images
landmark layout, viewpoint and crop requirements
source/rights disposition for each asset and actual-gameplay publication permission
inputs.retrieval_boundary: Use approved provided/reference material; do not assume a full-world export, game-repository access or redistribution rights.
inputs.independent_work: Prepare compositions and asset specifications; mark unapproved media unpublished, not authentic gameplay.

inputs.title: Compatible client and approved distribution
required_resolution_fields: client/build identity and supported OS/architecture matrix
immutable artifact identity, approved URL and applicable integrity/signing evidence
compatibility with intended world/profile and publication eligibility
inputs.retrieval_boundary: Inspect the existing Downloads lifecycle and allowed release records; external updater/signing/activation stays separately gated.
inputs.independent_work: Design download/withdrawn/unsupported states; never publish a random archive to fill a gap.

inputs.title: Actual player flow and safe test context
required_resolution_fields: supported account verification, character creation and client login sequence
exact client/world pair and authorized isolated test identities
allowed execution environment, redaction and recovery procedure
inputs.retrieval_boundary: Verify Platform-side contracts first; exact client/game/environment actions need their own authority.
inputs.independent_work: Test isolated Portal boundaries and document the external seam; do not label Portal-only tests as world-entry E2E.

inputs.title: Published content and catalog inventory
required_resolution_fields: required page/slugs and EN/PL publication and freshness state
approved active catalog/profile and explicit coverage inventory
authorized publication path, media references and previous revisions
inputs.retrieval_boundary: Reuse existing CMS, typed editorial queries, Downloads, Wiki/Game Catalog and content-programme ownership; no new duplicate importer.
inputs.independent_work: Prepare reviewed drafts and inventories only; runtime content counts remain unknown without authorized evidence.

inputs.title: Exact named launch-scope dispositions
required_resolution_fields: exact named release-capability inventory and required route coverage
one canonical owner-approved IMPLEMENT/DEFER/REJECT record per applicable capability
explicit decisions for conditional tools, richer community and commerce
inputs.retrieval_boundary: Resolve docs/agents/programs/OTERYN_PORTAL_COMPLETION_SCOPE.json with its accepted architecture owners; this input register cannot replace those records.
inputs.independent_work: Preserve existing dispositions; do not promote deferred features or claim global completion.

inputs.title: Environment, deployed identity and recovery authority
required_resolution_fields: authorized read/publication/deployment scope for the exact target
deployed release/build identity and approved content/media revision manifest
last-good compatible recovery target, required backup/restore proof and operator responsibility
inputs.retrieval_boundary: Repository evidence is not environment authority; use the existing guarded rollout and fail closed for unauthorized protected operations.
inputs.independent_work: Continue source/docs and isolated tests; no live account/content mutation, deployment or implied background monitoring.
